CustomField.description: Total discount for this line item including volume discount, contracted discount, and additional discount.
CustomField.formula: IF(ProratedListPrice__c == 0, 0, IF(ISPICKVAL(DiscountScheduleType__c, 'Slab') && NOT(Existing__c), IF(Quantity__c == 0, 0, (ProratedListPrice__c * Quantity__c - CustomerPrice__c) / (Quantity__c * ProratedListPrice__c)), IF(ISPICKVAL(DiscountScheduleType__c, 'Slab') && Existing__c, IF(Quantity__c == PriorQuantity__c, 0, (ProratedListPrice__c * (Quantity__c-PriorQuantity__c) - CustomerPrice__c) / ((Quantity__c-PriorQuantity__c) * ProratedListPrice__c)), (ProratedListPrice__c - CustomerPrice__c) / ProratedListPrice__c)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total discount for this line item including volume discount, contracted discount, and additional discount.
CustomField.label: Total Discount (%)
